title: Why Podcasts Just Dethroned Radio
hook: Podcasts just inched past radio, after a hundred years of radio on top.
closing: Radio had a hundred years of head start, and it still lost. Your ears have moved on.
question: Podcasts or radio: which do you play?

segments.say: Podcast listening quadrupled over the past decade, now 40 percent of spoken-word time.
Podcasts just edged ahead of radio by one point, to 40 percent.
About 35 percent of Americans now press play on a podcast every single week.
